content.text: All of today's loot is right here, ready to unbox!
@Nina Wow, the pile of express boxes is so spectacular! Looking forward to your unboxing.
First, take a look at the packaging of this coat—it's been long awaited!
@Nina The coat looks great! Looking forward to seeing how it looks on you.
It looks amazing on me, I feel like a star!
@Nina This coat really suits you! The color and style are a perfect match.
I took apart a pair of high heels, and I'm super satisfied!
@Mia The design of these high heels is quite unique; they must be very stable to walk in, right?
Oh no, there's a hole in this sweater!
@Nina, contact customer service quickly, this hole is too obvious!
The customer service actually refuses to acknowledge the issue, what should I do?
@Nina, take a photo of the express waybill to check for any logistics issues.
The outer packaging really has dents; it seems like rough handling during shipping.

According to the "Consumer Rights Protection Law," you have the right to request a refund. As stipulated in Article 24 of the "Consumer Rights Protection Law," if a product has quality issues, you can directly request a return and refund within 7 days of receiving the item, regardless of whether they acknowledge it or not. Since your sweater has a hole, which constitutes a quality issue, you are fully entitled to return it in accordance with the law.
Everyone, take a look at these high heels. The tissue packaging is quite nice, isn't it?
@Nina These shoes look very high-quality and would be a perfect match with that coat!
Wow, this packaging is really thoughtful, making the shoes look very high-end.
However, this sweater wasn't so lucky. Take a look at this hole...
@Nina This hole is really a bit too much. What did customer service say?
The customer service still won't admit it, just look at this chat log.
@Nina This is really infuriating! Quickly use legal grounds to argue with them.
@Vivi Thank you, I will continue to follow up. I hope it can be resolved as soon as possible.
It seems there really is a problem with the logistics. My picture frame was also broken before.
Today is really a Mercury retrograde day; I hope things go smoother from now on.
@Una It's a shame that your picture frame broke. I hope it will be intact next time.
Everyone must remember to take photos for evidence, as it will make it easier to protect your rights in the future.
That's right, I've already learned it. Thank you all for your support!
Next, I hope everyone has a pleasant shopping experience!
Everyone, take a look at the corner of this express box; it's simply unbelievable.
@Nina The corners of the outer box are all dented like this; it must be due to rough handling by the logistics.
@Nina Indeed, when taking photos of the express waybill, it was clear that the logistics weren't very efficient.
My picture frame is also shattered like this, I'm really speechless.
@Una Today is really a Mercury retrograde day; everyone's luck seems to be off.
I am ready to use the Consumer Rights Protection Law to defend my rights.
@Nina Use legal grounds to negotiate with customer service, and be sure to persist.
@Nina I see you already have successful cases, keep up the good work!
I hope these issues can be resolved smoothly going forward.
Yeah, it feels like Vivi's suggestions are all very useful.
@Vivi Thank you for your help, I will contact customer service right away.
You're welcome, I hope your issue gets resolved soon.
Courier issues are indeed a headache; next time, be more careful when choosing a logistics company.
Everyone must pay attention, both product quality and logistics issues need to be thoroughly considered.
Although today has been a bit frustrating, these complimentary samples are quite interesting.
@Mia The sample looks quite rich, which is a small comfort.
@Mia How is the quality of these samples? I hope they can make up for some of today's losses.
The silk pajamas I bought this time are of good quality; look at these details.
@Chloe The silk has a great sheen, it seems the quality is indeed good.
Good news, customer service has finally agreed to a refund. Thank you all for your support!
@Nina That's great, at least the effort wasn't in vain.
@Nina The issue of rough handling in logistics is truly frustrating; hopefully, it will improve in the future.
@Vivi Logistics is indeed a major issue, especially with the corners dented like this.
@Chloe Logistics violence often leads to item damage; I really hope there can be a better solution.
We can explore other ways to protect our rights, such as choosing more reliable logistics companies.
@Una That's a good suggestion, perhaps requiring more in-depth investigation.
Thank you for everyone's help; at least today's matters have come to a close.
@Nina Yes, I hope the next shopping experience will go more smoothly!
Everyone, take a look at these flattened delivery boxes—it's truly a pitiful sight.
@Vivi This is really not environmentally friendly and can easily lead to damage of items. The logistics company should consider making improvements.
@Una is right! The design of express delivery boxes should be more durable.
@Vivi These boxes all show signs of rough handling. Logistics violence is really a big issue.
I'm packing up to return the items, hoping everything goes smoothly this time.
@Nina The packaging seems very sturdy, so there shouldn't be any issues this time.
@Nina If you have any issues, remember to contact customer service. I support you.
Sometimes I really wish couriers could handle our packages more gently.
@Mia Yes, couriers are under a lot of pressure, but I still hope they can be more careful.
The courier just came to pick up the package, hoping it can be returned smoothly.
@Nina This time it should be fine, stay optimistic!
The courier looks very professional, so it should go smoothly.
Looking forward to you receiving the refund smoothly.
Thank you for your support. I will continue to monitor the logistics issues.
Finally got the refund, it was so hard.
@Nina That's great! It seems that defending rights is effective, and we've finally succeeded.
@Nina Congratulations! But logistics issues can really be a headache.
Yeah, the glass in my picture frame broke, and it still hasn't been fixed yet.
@Una, have you tried contacting the logistics company? Or using legal means like Nina did?
I've contacted customer service, but they keep shirking responsibility. I'm also considering what to do next.
Actually, you could try legal means, like Nina did. Try to gather as much evidence as possible, such as damaged packaging and delivery slips.
@Vivi Yes, evidence is important. Una, did you take photos for proof?
I've taken some, but I'm not sure if they're comprehensive enough.
@Una, you can also take more photos, especially of the damaged packaging, as this will provide stronger evidence of the issue.
Yes, rough handling in logistics is indeed a major issue that everyone needs to be aware of.
@Chloe Yes, sometimes we might need to put some pressure on the logistics company as well.
I hope the logistics company can strengthen its management to reduce the occurrence of such situations.
I will continue to work hard and hope to resolve this issue smoothly. Thank you all for your suggestions!
You're welcome, we help each other out. Hopefully, our next unboxing will go more smoothly.

meta.full_summary:
对话开始。
(第1段摘要): Nina开箱大衣后展示效果，大家夸赞。Mia拆高跟鞋满意，但Nina发现毛衣有破洞，与客服交涉未果。通过物流包装证明问题所在，Vivi提供法律依据帮助维权。
(第2段摘要): Nina展示高跟鞋包装，大家称赞包装用心。随后发现毛衣有破洞，客服不承认问题，Vivi建议用法律依据维权。大家感叹物流问题，鼓励Nina继续维权。
(第3段摘要): Nina展示了快递盒受损的角落，大家讨论物流暴力的问题。Una展示了画框碎裂的情况，展示了物流问题的普遍性。Nina准备用法律手段维权，Vivi给予支持和建议。
(第4段摘要): Nina成功维权，获得退款。大家对物流暴力问题进行讨论，寻找解决方案。真丝睡衣质量被称赞，赠品小样作为安慰。
(第5段摘要): 大家讨论物流暴力的问题，Vivi展示被踩扁的快递箱。Nina展示自己的退货包裹，快递员顺利取件。
(第6段摘要): Nina成功收到退款，大家继续讨论物流暴力的问题，Vivi建议Una收集证据维权。
resolved_events: Nina的退货准备和快递员取件
active_events: Una的画框玻璃碎裂问题未解决
物流暴力问题仍未彻底解决
